date_note: Date of Rokkatei's notice; the altered payment screen was live from 21 Oct 21:00 to 18 Nov 11:00 (times as in the notice).
title: Rokkatei online shop payment screen altered; about 8,000 card records may have leaked
summary: Rokkatei says it found on 18 November that the payment-screen program of its online shop had been altered by a third party. Customers who entered card details between 21 October 21:00 and 18 November 11:00 may be affected: about 8,000, a count confirmed so far that may change. Card number, holder name, expiry date and security code may have leaked. The shop is suspended.
plain: Japanese confectioner Rokkatei says its web shop's payment page was tampered with, so card details typed in over about four weeks may have leaked.
exec: A retailer's checkout was altered, putting about 8,000 cases of card details (the company's count, unit not specified) at risk and the shop offline.
action: Customers who paid by card on the Rokkatei online shop between 21 October and 18 November should check card statements and contact their card issuer; Rokkatei will contact those affected.

validation.note: Rokkatei's own notice (primary) and Cybersecurity.com, which relays it, both read; count is the company's 'confirmed so far' figure.

review.note: Notice gives about 8,000 as cases, confirmed so far; exec said customers' card details; now says about 8,000 cases, unit not specified. Date, window, data items, suspension match the notice
